Author: Serpens66
Name: Spectator
Description: Spectator perspectives, live statistics and local AI testing tools.

Changes: First release in the Serps Mods pack. The spectator features of Bugfixes and QoL now live in this separate mod; its spectator-view and eliminated-player settings are taken over once.
Spectators and eliminated players can switch the displayed player, reports and ally view through the portrait bar.
Optional: spectators control the selected player in singleplayer skirmishes (off by default).
Eliminated players can keep watching with spectator views (host option).
The detailed Vanilla statistics screen can be opened during the match.
Lord overview via the crown button, with host permission for extra enemy statistics.
Test tools for spectators and an AI lord test mode for active single-player participants; both are off by default, disabled in real multiplayer and not available in the map editor.
